sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the second bail application filed by applicants under Section 439 o f Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.323/2022, registered at Police Station-Athner District Betul (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)I, 506 of IPC & Section 5L, 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 05.08.2022 for a period of 11/2 years.
Prosecutrix and other material witnesses have already been examined.
There is no chances that applicant will be able to influence witnesses of the case or tamper with evidence.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
